tag_tree_metadata.consequence: Zenodo's GitHub integration builds the new version's metadata from the release's tree (.zenodo.json, else CITATION.cff); the tag tree carries CITATION.cff version 1.3.0, so the auto-created record would state version 1.3.0 until its metadata is edited (version, description from reproduction/r6/ZENODO_DESCRIPTION_v1.4.2.md); the creators are the same either way.

push.command: git push --atomic origin main v1.4.0 v1.4.1 v1.4.2 emsr933-v1

go_push_sequence: git -C <main checkout> push --atomic origin main v1.4.0 v1.4.1 v1.4.2 emsr933-v1

gh release create v1.4.2 --repo vaspapa79/sfincs-mediterranean-flood --title "v1.4.2" --notes-file <the CHANGELOG v1.4.2 section>   (one release: the Zenodo webhook mints one version DOI per GitHub release)
poll https://zenodo.org/api/records?q=conceptrecid:20523154&all_versions=true until the new version appears; report its DOI URL and the release URL
then edit the new Zenodo version's metadata (version 1.4.2, description = ZENODO_DESCRIPTION_v1.4.2.md) — creators unchanged
delete the local backup refs refs/backup/code21/* and refs/rewritten/* once the push is verified (git for-each-ref refs/backup/code21 | cut -f2 | xargs -n1 git update-ref -d)
